honeypot.label: Honeypot field
honeypot.description: Adds a hidden field that bots fill in but humans never see.

time_gate.label: Minimum submission time
time_gate.description: Rejects submissions completed faster than a human could type.

nonce.label: Signature verification
nonce.description: Requires a valid, server-signed form token confirming the submission originated from this site. Unlike a WordPress nonce it does not expire, so it is safe with full-page caching.

link_limit.label: Link limit
link_limit.description: Flags submissions containing too many URLs.

keyword_block.label: Blocked keywords
keyword_block.description: Rejects submissions containing known spam keywords or patterns.

duplicate.label: Duplicate submission detection
duplicate.description: Rejects identical submissions sent within a short time window.

rate_limit.label: Rate limit
rate_limit.description: Throttles repeated submissions from the same sender (logged-in user or IP) within a short window. Off by default; useful for authenticated flows such as private messages.

behavioral.label: Behavioral analysis
behavioral.description: Scores submissions based on mouse movements, clicks, and time on page to detect bot-like patterns.
